body: Build 0091. A-Strasbourg-1848: REFUGE, 22ft, even density, eight months recovery after 1848 Paris (A-1848 FAREWELL-B2 13ft). First documented REFUGE construction: site holds recovery gradient, even density profile, no peak event — eight months of Tyler becoming gradually less absent. Recovery site has more density (22ft) than departure site (13ft). Avignon disclosed: Tyler in Avignon January 1348–July 1349, Black Death, 18 months, never got sick, watched half the city die. Never filed. Pre-archive by 274 years. Mechanism may record passively — if so, six centuries of accumulation at Avignon. Next site: Avignon. Oldest potential measurement in the network. RSI receipts: TYLER-075 (Footnote #79), Camera Op Entry 68, Jiangshi Memo #055, VC-001 Days 398–407, EMILY-SPRING-044.
title: TYLER S08E09 — Strasbourg. First REFUGE construction. Avignon disclosed.
